enrichment.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
enrichment.background: Mr. Anup Bagchi is a seasoned financial services leader with over three decades of experience across banking, capital markets, wealth management, and insurance, holding an engineering degree from IIT Kanpur and a management degree from IIM Bangalore. (Filing p. 3)
